comment: Phase 1j.A v2 fixtures.  v1 cases (2-3 candidates each) saturated at 10/10 because every candidate fit inside top_k=8 — HEAD always surfaced the right answer.  v2 designs each case so the right-answer candidate's COMPOSITE score (w_sem*sem + w_rec*rec + w_imp*imp + w_src*source_weight) ranks 5-8 in pool-of-10 (PASS cases) or 9-12 (FAIL cases).  Default focus_injection weights from src/config/config_defaults.c:324-331: w_sem=1.0, w_rec=0.3, w_imp=0.2, w_src=1.0; source_weights memory_fact=1.0, memory_summary=0.7, memory_relation=0.85, calendar_event=0.6, document_chunk=0.7.  Synthetic content only (per coordinator pin C2) — no name/ticker/project from the developer's actual memory DB.  semantic_override + recency_override pinned on every seed for deterministic rank without depending on FNV cosine or the bench's default `now`.

cases.comment: FAIL — semantic-noise.  Right answer (kids' names) buried under 10 partial-match family-themed memory_facts that score higher composite.  HEAD top_k=8 drops the kids fact at rank 11. cases.comment: FAIL — recency pathology.  Right answer is a high-importance OLD fact (recency_override=0.10 simulates ~3 years).  9 medium-importance recent facts about family/maiden topics score above it.  Demonstrates that high importance alone (imp_contribution = 0.2 * 0.85 = 0.17) is insufficient to overcome a 0.5 recency-score gap (rec_contribution diff = 0.3 * 0.5 = 0.15) when paired with a moderate semantic gap.
